package ntcharts3d

import (
	"fmt"
	"image"
	"image/color"
	"io"
	"reflect"
 "os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	tea "charm.land/bubbletea/v2"
	"nimbleterminal.dev/nt3d"
	picture "nimbleterminal.dev/ntpicture"
)

// presentationPump executes Batch commands concurrently and preserves Sequence
// output ordering. Retire timers remain in flight across measured frames.
// It is an application-side sink, not a terminal emulator or Tea screen renderer.
type presentationPump struct {
	tb                                       testing.TB
 allowResize bool
	m                                        *Model
	rendered, completed, rawBytes, gridBytes int
	render, output                           time.Duration
	submitted                                time.Time
	size                                     image.Point
	hook                                     func()
	delay                                    time.Duration
	events                                   chan presentationEvent
	active                                   int
	starts                                   map[uint64]time.Time
	media                                    map[uint64]picture.KittyMedium
	directFrames, shmFrames                  int
}

type presentationEvent struct {
	msg    tea.Msg
	follow []tea.Cmd
}

func (p *presentationPump) launch(cmd tea.Cmd, follow []tea.Cmd) {
	if cmd == nil {
		if len(follow) > 0 {
			p.launch(follow[0], follow[1:])
		}
		return
	}
	p.active++
	go func() { p.events <- presentationEvent{cmd(), follow} }()
}

func (p *presentationPump) run(cmd tea.Cmd) {
	if p.events == nil {
		p.events = make(chan presentationEvent, 256)
		p.starts = make(map[uint64]time.Time)
		p.media = make(map[uint64]picture.KittyMedium)
	}
	before := p.completed
	p.launch(cmd, nil)
	deadline := time.NewTimer(10 * time.Second)
	defer deadline.Stop()
	for p.active > 0 {
		if !p.m.closed && p.completed > before && p.completed == p.rendered && !p.m.busy && !p.m.dirty && !p.m.PictureStatus().Busy {
			return
		}
		select {
		case event := <-p.events:
			p.active--
			msg := event.msg
			switch v := msg.(type) {
			case tea.BatchMsg:
				for _, child := range v {
					p.launch(child, nil)
				}
			case tea.RawMsg:
				s, ok := v.Msg.(string)
				if !ok {
					p.tb.Fatalf("unexpected raw payload %T", v.Msg)
				}
				if p.delay > 0 {
					time.Sleep(p.delay)
				}
				n, err := io.WriteString(io.Discard, s)
				if err != nil {
					p.tb.Fatal(err)
				}
				p.rawBytes += n
			default:
				value := reflect.ValueOf(msg)
				if msg != nil && value.Kind() == reflect.Slice && value.Type().Elem() == reflect.TypeOf(tea.Cmd(nil)) {
					sequence := make([]tea.Cmd, value.Len())
					for i := range sequence {
						sequence[i] = value.Index(i).Interface().(tea.Cmd)
					}
					sequence = append(sequence, event.follow...)
					if len(sequence) > 0 {
						p.launch(sequence[0], sequence[1:])
					}
					continue
				}
				if msg != nil {
					p.route(msg)
				}
			}
			if len(event.follow) > 0 {
				p.launch(event.follow[0], event.follow[1:])
			}
		case <-deadline.C:
			p.tb.Fatal("presentation did not settle")
		}
	}
}

func (p *presentationPump) route(msg tea.Msg) {
	switch v := msg.(type) {
	case rendered:
		if v.err != nil || v.renderMode != reviewMode() || v.frame == nil {
			p.tb.Fatalf("render fallback/error: %+v", v)
		}
		if v.frame.Bounds().Size() != p.size {
			p.tb.Fatalf("raster changed: %v want %v", v.frame.Bounds(), p.size)
		}
		p.rendered++
		p.render += v.elapsed
		p.submitted = time.Now()
	case picture.ErrorMsg:
		p.tb.Fatal(v.Err)
	case picture.PresentedMsg:
		if v.Owner == p.m.pic {
			p.completed++
			start, ok := p.starts[v.Generation]
			if !ok {
 if !p.allowResize {p.tb.Fatalf("unmatched completion %d", v.Generation)}
 // Resize may re-present the retained image without a new rendered message.
 p.rendered++; start=time.Now()
 }
			p.output += time.Since(start)
			delete(p.starts, v.Generation)
			if p.m.PictureMode() == picture.PictureKitty {
				if p.media[v.Generation] == picture.KittyMediumSharedMemory {
					p.shmFrames++
				} else {
					p.directFrames++
				}
			}
			delete(p.media, v.Generation)
			n, err := io.WriteString(io.Discard, p.m.View().Content)
			if err != nil {
				p.tb.Fatal(err)
			}
			p.gridBytes += n
		}
	}
	previous := p.m.PictureStatus().Presented
	_, next := p.m.Update(msg)
	status := p.m.PictureStatus()
	if status.Presented != previous {
		p.media[status.Presented] = status.Medium
	}
	if _, ok := msg.(rendered); ok {
		p.starts[status.Generation] = p.submitted
	}
	if _, ok := msg.(rendered); ok && p.hook != nil {
		hook := p.hook
		p.hook = nil
		hook()
	}
	p.launch(next, nil)
	if !p.m.closed && (p.m.shrink != 0 || p.m.RenderMode() != reviewMode()) {
		p.tb.Fatal("adaptive quality changed; sample invalid")
	}
}

func presentationFixture(tb testing.TB, mode, workload string, cols, rows int) (*presentationPump, *image.RGBA) {
	tb.Helper()
	kitty, shared := picture.KittyCapabilityUnsupported, picture.KittyCapabilityUnsupported
	medium := picture.KittyMediumDirect
	if mode != "glyph" {
		kitty = picture.KittyCapabilitySupported
	}
	if mode == "shm" {
		if !picture.KittySharedMemorySupported() {
			tb.Skip("shared memory unavailable on this platform")
		}
		shared, medium = picture.KittyCapabilitySupported, picture.KittyMediumSharedMemory
	}
	noTmux := false
	session := picture.NewTerminalSession(picture.TerminalOptions{Kitty: kitty, SharedMemory: shared, CellPixelWidth: 8, CellPixelHeight: 16, TmuxPassthrough: &noTmux})
	m := New(cols, rows, WithRenderMode(reviewMode()), WithAutoRotate(false), WithTerminalSession(session), WithKittyMedium(medium), WithKittyFormat(picture.KittyFormatZlib), WithAxes(Axes{X: Axis{Hidden: true}, Y: Axis{Hidden: true}, Z: Axis{Hidden: true}}))
	src := image.NewRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, 512, 512))
	for y := range 512 {
		for x := range 512 {
			c := color.RGBA{218, 226, 206, 255}
			switch {
			case (x+y/3)%512 < 512/12:
				c = color.RGBA{120, 175, 210, 255}
			case x%32 < 3 || y%32 < 3:
				c = color.RGBA{245, 240, 225, 255}
			default:
				c.R -= uint8((x/32+y/32)%5) * 8
			}
			src.SetRGBA(x, y, c)
		}
	}
	tex, err := NewTexture(src)
	if err != nil {
		tb.Fatal(err)
	}
	m.SetColorLegendVisible(false)
	m.SetCamera(Camera{Alpha: 55, Beta: -90, Distance: 3.4, Projection: Perspective})
	if workload == "bars" {
		m.SetBars("bars", Bars{NX: 8, NY: 4, Values: []float32{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 1, 3, 5, 7, 7, 5, 3, 1, 8, 6, 4, 2}})
	} else {
		m.SetSurface("map", Surface{NX: 2, NY: 2, Z: make([]float32, 4), MinX: -1, MaxX: 1, MinY: -1, MaxY: 1, Material: &Material{Texture: tex, Unlit: true}})
	}
	p := &presentationPump{tb: tb, m: m, size: image.Pt(cols*8, (rows-2)*16)}
	if mode == "glyph" {
		p.size = image.Pt(cols, (rows-2)*2)
	}
	tb.Cleanup(func() { p.run(m.Dispose()); _ = m.Close(); session.Close() })
	p.run(m.Init())
	if m.Err() != nil || p.completed != 1 || m.PictureStatus().Busy {
		tb.Fatalf("warmup failed: %v %+v", m.Err(), m.PictureStatus())
	}
	if mode != "glyph" && (m.PictureMode() != picture.PictureKitty || m.PictureStatus().Medium != medium) {
		tb.Fatalf("transport fallback: %+v", m.PictureStatus())
	}
	return p, src
}

func BenchmarkPresentation(b *testing.B) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"glyph", "direct", "shm"} {
		for _, work := range []string{"camera", "texture", "bars", "burst"} {
			b.Run(mode+"/"+work, func(b *testing.B) {
				p, src := presentationFixture(b, mode, work, 80, 22)
				p.rendered, p.completed, p.rawBytes, p.gridBytes = 0, 0, 0, 0
				p.render, p.output = 0, 0
				p.directFrames, p.shmFrames = 0, 0
				var prep time.Duration
				requested := 0
				b.ReportAllocs()
				b.ResetTimer()
				for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
					start := time.Now()
					var cmd tea.Cmd
					if work == "texture" {
						tex, err := NewTexture(src)
						if err != nil {
							b.Fatal(err)
						}
						cmd = p.m.SetSeriesTexture("map", tex)
					} else {
						c := p.m.Camera()
						c.Beta = -90 + float64(i%72)*5
						cmd = p.m.SetCamera(c)
					}
					requested++
					prep += time.Since(start)
					if work == "burst" {
						p.delay = time.Millisecond
						p.hook = func() {
							for j := 0; j < 3; j++ {
								c := p.m.Camera()
								c.Beta += 5
								requested++
								if next := p.m.SetCamera(c); next != nil {
									b.Fatal("producer escaped presentation backpressure")
								}
							}
						}
					}
					p.run(cmd)
					if p.m.busy || p.m.PictureStatus().Busy || p.m.dirty {
						b.Fatal("unsettled presentation")
					}
				}
				b.StopTimer()
				b.ReportMetric(float64(p.directFrames), "direct-frames")
				b.ReportMetric(float64(p.shmFrames), "shm-frames")
				b.ReportMetric(float64(requested), "requested")
				b.ReportMetric(float64(p.completed), "completed")
				b.ReportMetric(float64(requested-p.completed), "coalesced")
				b.ReportMetric(float64(p.render.Nanoseconds())/float64(p.rendered), "render-ns/frame")
				b.ReportMetric(float64(prep.Nanoseconds())/float64(b.N), "prepare-ns/op")
				b.ReportMetric(float64(p.output.Nanoseconds())/float64(p.completed), "output-ns/frame")
				b.ReportMetric(float64(p.rawBytes)/float64(p.completed), "protocol-B/frame")
				b.ReportMetric(float64(p.gridBytes)/float64(p.completed), "view-B/frame")
				b.Logf("raster=%v renderer=%v picture=%v transport=%+v aniso=%d shrink=%g frames=%d", p.size, p.m.RenderMode(), p.m.PictureMode(), p.m.PictureStatus(), p.m.anisotropy, p.m.shrink, p.rendered)
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestPresentationPump(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"glyph", "direct", "shm"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			p, _ := presentationFixture(t, mode, "camera", 8, 6)
			p.hook = func() {
				for i := range 3 {
					c := p.m.Camera()
					c.Beta += float64(i + 1)
					if cmd := p.m.SetCamera(c); cmd != nil {
						t.Fatal("missing backpressure")
					}
				}
			}
			c := p.m.Camera()
			c.Beta += 5
			p.run(p.m.SetCamera(c))
			if p.completed != 3 || p.rendered != 3 || p.m.PictureStatus().Busy {
				t.Fatal(fmt.Sprintf("burst did not coalesce: %+v", p))
			}
		})
	}
}

// Isolate renderer lifetime from encoding and from upstream sampling changes.
// v0.2.0's renderer is stateless; this measures whether retention alone helps.
func BenchmarkSoftwareRendererLifetime(b *testing.B) {
	for _, work := range []string{"camera", "bars"} {
		for _, retain := range []bool{false, true} {
			b.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/retain=%t", work, retain), func(b *testing.B) {
				p, _ := presentationFixture(b, "glyph", work, 80, 22)
				frame := engineFrame(p.m.frameSized(640, 320, 2, Software))
				renderer := nt3d.NewSoftwareRenderer()
				defer renderer.Close()
				if _, err := renderer.Render(frame); err != nil {
					b.Fatal(err)
				}
				b.ReportAllocs()
				b.ResetTimer()
				for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
					r := renderer
					if !retain {
						r = nt3d.NewSoftwareRenderer()
					}
					img, err := r.Render(frame)
					if err != nil || img.Bounds().Size() != image.Pt(640, 320) {
						b.Fatal("invalid rendering", err)
					}
					if !retain {
						_ = r.Close()
					}
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func reviewMode() RenderMode { if os.Getenv("OSM_REVIEW_GPU")=="1" {return WebGPU}; return Software }
